sourceFingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 over the covered paths in DECLARED ORDER; each path contributes <repo-relative path> NUL <64-hex sha256 of the file's RAW BYTES> NUL; per-file digest = script/m24/portability.ts sha256File() (node:crypto, no process spawn)

verdict.note: `failed` counts real functional failures only; mutant runs are reported separately via the verdict block. `mutantsNotJudged` counts a mutant the harness could not judge (missing anchor or an import failure) — an import failure is NOT counted as caught, because the oracle never ran. The pre-lane suite reported 5/5 caught while all five mutants had died on an unrewritten `./signature` import.

limitations: adapter proven against a fixture double reproducing the engine contract; the engine itself is M14-verified and exercised end-to-end by the V1 harness
heuristic edges from the engine are included; their ratio is declared by the engine's provenance
ranges for engine nodes use line-level precision when the engine lacks byte columns
latency measured on this machine only; cross-platform budgets are M25 scope

the machine-readable absence reason is carried on the component result; src/lsp/server.ts (another lane) maps the wire response and currently returns a bare `null` / bare `[]` — the exact patch is reported
the declared-absence and staleness vocabulary lives in src/lsp/symbols.ts (this lane owns both files); a dedicated src/lsp/declared_absence.ts owner would be the right home and is reported
